description:
The One Nation One Ration Card scheme was launched by the Government of India on June 24, 2020. 

This initiative aims to provide food security to all eligible beneficiaries under the National Food Security Act of 2013. 

The scheme is designed to ensure that beneficiaries can access their entitled food grains from any Fair Price Shop across the country. 

This is particularly beneficial for migrant workers and their families who often move from one state to another in search of employment. 

The primary objective of the One Nation One Ration Card scheme is to provide seamless access to subsidized food grains to all eligible individuals. 

The scheme aims to eliminate the challenges faced by migrants in accessing their food entitlements. 

The government has set a target to implement this scheme across all states and Union Territories by March 2021. 

As of October 2023, 36 states and Union Territories have successfully implemented the One Nation One Ration Card system. 

Under this scheme, beneficiaries can avail of food grains at a subsidized rate of ₹2 per kg for wheat and ₹3 per kg for rice. 

The scheme allows beneficiaries to receive their entitled food grains even if they are not in their home state. 

This is particularly important for the estimated 10 crore migrant workers in India. 

The scheme also aims to reduce the leakages in the Public Distribution System. 

It is expected to enhance transparency and efficiency in the distribution of food grains. 

The eligibility criteria for the One Nation One Ration Card scheme include individuals who are registered under the National Food Security Act. 

Beneficiaries must possess a ration card that is linked to the Aadhaar number. 

The scheme is applicable to all families that fall under the Below Poverty Line category. 

The scheme also extends to those who are part of the Antyodaya Anna Yojana. 

Individuals must ensure that their ration card details are updated in the system. 

The application process for the One Nation One Ration Card scheme involves several steps. 

First, eligible beneficiaries must visit their local food and civil supplies department office. 

They need to fill out an application form for the ration card. 

The required documents include proof of identity, proof of residence, and Aadhaar number. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be verified by the concerned authorities. 

Upon successful verification, the ration card will be issued. 

Beneficiaries can then access their food grains from any Fair Price Shop across the country. 

The timeline for the application process may vary by state. 

However, the government aims to process applications within 30 days of submission. 

Disbursement of food grains under the One Nation One Ration Card scheme occurs monthly. 

Beneficiaries can collect their entitled food grains at any time during the month. 

The implementing authority for the One Nation One Ration Card scheme is the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution. 

The department responsible for the scheme at the state level is the Food and Civil Supplies Department. 

Beneficiaries can contact the helpline number 1800 180 1100 for assistance related to the scheme. 

The One Nation One Ration Card scheme is supported by technology. 

The government has integrated the scheme with the National Food Security Act database. 

This integration allows for real-time tracking of beneficiaries and their entitlements. 

The scheme also utilizes biometric authentication to ensure that only eligible beneficiaries receive the food grains. 

As of October 2023, approximately 80 crore beneficiaries are covered under the One Nation One Ration Card scheme. 

The government has allocated ₹1.5 lakh crore for the implementation of this scheme. 

This allocation is part of the larger food subsidy budget of the government. 

The scheme is expected to significantly reduce food insecurity among vulnerable populations. 

It is also projected to improve the nutritional status of families across the country. 

The One Nation One Ration Card scheme is a crucial step towards achieving the Sustainable Development Goal of Zero Hunger. 

The government has reported a reduction in the number of complaints related to ration distribution since the implementation of this scheme. 

The scheme has also received positive feedback from various stakeholders, including civil society organizations. 

The government continues to promote awareness about the One Nation One Ration Card scheme. 

Awareness campaigns are conducted through various media platforms. 

These campaigns aim to educate beneficiaries about the benefits and procedures of the scheme. 

The One Nation One Ration Card scheme is part of the broader Digital India initiative. 

This initiative aims to leverage technology to improve governance and service delivery. 

The scheme has the potential to transform the Public Distribution System in India. 

It addresses long-standing issues related to food security and access to essential commodities. 

The government is committed to ensuring that the scheme reaches its full potential. 

Regular monitoring and evaluation are conducted to assess the impact of the scheme. 

The One Nation One Ration Card scheme is a landmark initiative in India's welfare landscape. 

It represents a significant shift towards a more inclusive and efficient food distribution system. 

The scheme is expected to benefit millions of Indians in the coming years. 

The government is optimistic about the long-term outcomes of the One Nation One Ration Card scheme. 

It aims to create a more equitable society where every citizen has access to basic food needs. 

The One Nation One Ration Card scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to social welfare. 

It reflects the ongoing efforts to modernize and streamline welfare programs in India. 

The success of this scheme could serve as a model for future welfare initiatives. 

It highlights the importance of integrating technology with social welfare programs. 

The One Nation One Ration Card scheme is a crucial step towards achieving food security for all. 

The government continues to work towards expanding the reach and effectiveness of this scheme. 

It is an important part of India's strategy to combat poverty and hunger. 

The One Nation One Ration Card scheme is a significant achievement in the realm of social justice.
